decisions.reason: The hearty bread loaf builds directly on the firm's core baking knowledge, so it can be interpreted and refined in-house at low cost, which makes keeping it the natural choice.
The sweet pastry sits squarely within the firm's existing confectionery competence and fits its traditional range, so it is likely to be retained.
The crusty farmhouse bread draws on heritage recipes and the firm's craft know-how, giving it strong absorptive fit with little reason to drop it.
The poppy seed stollen won a gold award and has its own web page, showing the firm can read and build on clear positive feedback within its seasonal expertise.
The premium stollen won a gold award and strengthens the firm's established Christmas specialty and gift business, so keeping it is clearly warranted.
